title: Planet Tweaks V3.4.3 - Universal Revert & Safety Policy Unblock Release
releaseNotes: Planet Tweaks V3.4.3: (1) Universal Revert Engine: Completely resolved the 'Undo blocked by SafetyPolicy' issue. Tweaks without local pre-apply snapshots (such as tweaks applied externally or pre-existing in Windows) now gracefully and safely revert to clean Windows stock defaults with zero blockages. (2) FilterKeys & Revert Safety: 0 Delay Before Acceptance and FilterKeys flags can now be smoothly applied and reverted on demand. (3) UI & Version Alignment: Full v3.4.3 branding across all Windows chrome headers, Alt-Tab switcher, auto-updater endpoints, and Discord Rich Presence.
